name: Ring of Failed Performance, Improved
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 10th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As a ring of failed performance except the wearer suffers a -10 penalty to his Perform checks. Additionally any Perform check that fails by 5 or more points is considered a total failure and reduces the audience’s attitude by two steps.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse, followed by casting sculpt sound, upon it, destroying the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of inspired performance, improved

Identification DC 35
False Identification DC 25
